visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white line engraving depicting a dramatic, violent confrontation inside a stone building with architectural columns. A young man in Western-style clothing is in the center, lunging forward and grabbing an older man wearing a turban and robes by the throat. To the left, another man in a turban and robes is raising a long, thin weapon or stick above his head as if to strike. In the lower left, a figure is crouched or fallen on the ground. The background features stone walls and a decorative relief sculpture of a figure on a pillar.
visualDescription.visualObjectsEn: Stone columns, architectural relief sculpture, robes, turbans, long thin weapon or staff, stone floor, clothing with folds and textures.
visualDescription.recognizableCharactersOrPeopleEn: A young man in a jacket and trousers, an older man in a turban and robes being choked, a man in a turban and robes holding a weapon, a figure crouched on the floor.
